prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls & Shortcuts Quick Tour Screen: Adds a new controls tour screen right before the final home introduction to explain how to interact with, hide, or summon the desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple emails from users confused about how to control or hide their pet, and finish step completion drops to 64.8%.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Self-Test & Diagnostic Screen: Adds a new diagnostic screen during the home step to check screen overlay permissions and multi-monitor display compatibility before launching. (why: 3 support tickets report pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to open.)
2: [finish, hint] Desktop Overlay Permission Reminder Hint: Displays a clear reminder hint on the final welcome screen about granting OS screen overlay permissions. (why: Users report pets not showing on desktop after completing setup.)
3: [home, notification] Pet Ready Completion Audio Notification: Enables audio notifications and a ready signal when pet asset generation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to switch away.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Compact Path Selection Screen Layout: Switches the choose_path screen layout to a compact design with straightforward option highlights. (why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean is 514s, showing decision fatigue for some users.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Account Cloud Protection Guarantee: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly promise automatic cloud backup and pet retrieval upon re-login. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.)

scores.note: Finish step has high drop-off (35.2%) and strong email feedback, but adding a full new screen introduces extra friction.
Home step conversion is already high (86.0%) and support issues are low (3 tickets), making a new screen costly with minimal upside.
Target step loses 35.2%; adding an overlay permission hint addresses user confusion without adding multi-screen friction.
Extremely high mean wait time (2336s vs 201s median) indicates users tab away; audio cues effectively re-engage distracted users.
High mean time (514s) points to decision fatigue on choose_path, though support mail is silent on this specific screen.
Cheap copy-only change directly addressing 8 support tickets regarding pet data loss fear during sign-in drop-off (22.6%).
